what is #HMPV 
Human metapneumovirus (HMPV or hMPV) is a negative-sense single-stranded RNA virus of the family Pneumoviridae and is closely related to the Avian metapneumovirus (AMPV) subgroup C! a thread 🧵 https://t.co/i6vhgazsXH

what is #HMPV 
Human metapneumovirus (HMPV or hMPV) is a negative-sense single-stranded RNA virus of the family Pneumoviridae and is closely related to the Avian metapneumovirus (AMPV) subgroup C! a thread 🧵 https://t.co/i6vhgazsXH

nodes.author: Madhur_06
nodes.text: It was isolated for the first time in 2001 in "the Netherlands" by using the RAP-PCR (RNA arbitrarily primed PCR) technique for identification of unknown viruses growing in cultured cells!

nodes.author: Madhur_06
nodes.text: As of 2016, it(#HMPvirus) was the second most common cause (after respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)) of acute respiratory tract illness in otherwise-healthy children under the age of 5 in a large US outpatient clinic!!💔 #hmpvvirus https://t.co/zs7VurvrKP

nodes.author: Madhur_06
nodes.text: The peak age of hospitalization for infants with HMPV occurs between 6–12 months of age, slightly older than the peak of RSV, which is around 2–3 months!!💔 https://t.co/mgZlGBcHzb

nodes.author: Madhur_06
nodes.text: The clinical features and severity of HMPV are similar to those of RSV. HMPV is also an important cause of disease in older adults. A notable outbreak of HMPV has been observed through the end of 2024 in China!!💔 #hmpvvirus #HMPvirus https://t.co/SylWWida88

nodes.author: Madhur_06
nodes.text: The Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention published data showing that respiratory infections had risen significantly in the week of December 16 to 22, 2024!!💔 #HMPV #hmpvvirus #HMPvirus https://t.co/hAjNWFScXp

nodes.author: Madhur_06
nodes.text: human metapneumovirus was linked to 6.2 percent of positive respiratory illness tests and 5.4 percent of respiratory-illness hospitalizations in China, more than COVID-19, rhinovirus or adenovirus!! https://t.co/f7U83FYhO5

nodes.author: Madhur_06
nodes.text: Kan Biao, head of the China CDC's National Institute for Communicable Disease Control and Prevention, announced that the rate of HMPV among children ages 14 and under was on the rise in China!!💔 #HMPV #hmpvvirus #HMPvirus #HMPVoutbreak https://t.co/zOqC9LwA38
